A portable cabin in Central Delhi is a steel-frame, panel-built room that arrives factory-finished and is craned or hand-placed onto a compact footprint in dense markets like Connaught Place, Karol Bagh and Paharganj. Because it is built at our Greater Noida factory and delivered ready, you skip months of wet construction and start using the space in days, not seasons. This page explains sizes, build spec, what drives price, and how delivery works to congested Central Delhi streets.

Why a portable cabin suits Central Delhi's congested markets

Central Delhi commercial space is expensive and tight. A factory-built portable cabin fits the constraints here in three practical ways:

  • Compact footprint — units can be sized to a small corner plot, a setback strip or a rooftop, so you use land that a permanent shop cannot.
  • Congested-access friendly — narrow lanes around Chandni Chowk, Daryaganj and Paharganj make heavy site construction hard. A pre-built cabin is delivered as a finished box, so on-site work is minimal.
  • Fast to use — once the cabin is placed and connected, the space is ready quickly, instead of waiting out a multi-month build in a busy market.

Central Delhi sits under the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) and several heritage and market zones. A portable cabin is a dry-assembly, relocatable structure rather than permanent construction, which is why many buyers in these areas choose it for temporary, semi-permanent or relocatable use. OWNER FACT NEEDED: confirm we do NOT promise to obtain MCD permits/NOC on the buyer's behalf — old page claimed "we handle all permits"; recommend stating "buyer is responsible for local MCD permissions; we provide unit drawings and specs to support your application".

Portable cabin sizes and configurations

Cabins are built to order. Common Central Delhi uses and rough sizes:

  • Kiosk / booth — small single-room units for ticketing, info points, security or a tea/coffee counter.
  • Retail or display cabin — single room with a service window or glass front for a compact shopfront.
  • Cabin office — a portable cabin used as an office, with power points, lighting and an AC provision. (This is a portable cabin used as an office — not a separate product.)
  • Multi-room / partitioned cabin — internal partitions, optional toilet, and electricals for a working space.

Exact dimensions, door/window positions, partitions, toilet and electrical layout are decided at enquiry based on your site and use.

How a SAMAN portable cabin is built

Every cabin uses a structural steel approach, not a thin sheet box:

  • MS frame to IS 2062 structural steel for the base and skeleton.
  • ~50 mm insulated PUF sandwich panels (minimum 40 kg/m³ core density) for walls and roof, which helps keep interiors usable through Delhi's summer heat and monsoon.
  • Pre-galvanised steel skin and GI roofing for weather and corrosion resistance.
  • Powder-coated steel finish on the structure.
  • Built under an ISO 9001:2015 quality system.

Finishes such as glass fronts, panel cladding, branding wraps, shutters and lighting can be specified at order. We do not use fake brand signage or readable third-party logos on units.

What drives the price of a portable cabin

Portable cabin cost is quoted on request, not a fixed shelf price, because each unit is built to order. The main price factors are: overall size (floor area), panel type and thickness, level of insulation, whether a toilet or internal partitions are added, electrical fittings, exterior finish and branding, and delivery distance to your Central Delhi site. Send your size and use and we return a written quote.

Delivery is ₹3,000 default with typical 3–5 day transit from our Greater Noida factory; fully custom or fitted units may need a longer build window before dispatch.

Delivery and installation to Central Delhi

Our Greater Noida (Jalpura) factory is in the same region as Central Delhi, so dispatch is short-haul. The cabin is built and finished at the factory, then transported as a complete unit to your site. For tight market lanes around Connaught Place, Karol Bagh, Paharganj, Daryaganj and Chandni Chowk, access, crane or manual placement, and timing are confirmed at enquiry so the delivery suits the street and the unit size.

Inter-state movement from Uttar Pradesh into Delhi means standard tax and transport documentation applies (such as an E-way bill for consignments above ₹50,000). We handle the dispatch paperwork from our side.

Why buy factory-direct from SAMAN Portable

SAMAN Portable (SAMAN POS India Private Limited) has been serving India since 2009 and was incorporated in 2019. Buying direct from the manufacturer means:

  • Warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. (The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty.)
  • Returns: a 7-day return window from delivery (return transport cost is borne by the customer).
  • Direct quote and build: no reseller markup; the team that builds the cabin quotes it.
  • Manufacturer accountability: ISO 9001:2015 quality system and IS 2062 steel.

SAMAN has delivered 500+ projects across India. To compare options for your site, see our portable cabin range or a single-room cabin office unit.

FAQs about portable cabins in Central Delhi


How long does delivery to Central Delhi take?

Standard cabins typically reach Central Delhi in about 3–5 days of transit from our Greater Noida factory, with ₹3,000 default delivery. Fully custom or fitted units need a longer build window before dispatch, which we confirm in your written quote.


What does a portable cabin cost in Central Delhi?

Price is quoted on request because each cabin is built to order. The cost depends on size, panel thickness and insulation, toilet or partitions, electricals, finish and delivery distance. Send your size and intended use to get a written quote.


Do I need a permit for a portable cabin in Central Delhi?

Central Delhi falls under MCD and includes heritage and market zones, so local permissions or an NOC may apply depending on the site and use. The buyer is responsible for these approvals; we provide unit drawings and specifications to support your application. Check with the local authority before placement.


Can a portable cabin be relocated later?

Yes. A portable cabin is a dry-assembly, relocatable structure, so it can be lifted and moved to another site if your location changes. Relocation feasibility, crane or transport needs, and cost depend on the unit size and both sites' access.


What warranty comes with the cabin?

Every unit carries 5 years structural frame and base, 1–2 years finishing, and a 20–25 years engineered service life. The engineered service life describes how long the structure is built to last; it is not a warranty period.


How is a portable cabin built so it handles Delhi weather?

The structure uses an MS frame to IS 2062 with roughly 50 mm insulated PUF sandwich panels, pre-galvanised steel skin and GI roofing. The insulation helps keep interiors usable in summer heat, and the galvanised steel resists corrosion and monsoon exposure.

Get a portable cabin quote for Central Delhi

Tell us your size, intended use and exact Central Delhi location and we will send a written quote and unit drawing. Call +91 88616 22859 or send an enquiry, or reach us on WhatsApp at +91 88616 22859. We deliver across Central Delhi including Connaught Place, Karol Bagh, Paharganj, Daryaganj and Chandni Chowk.
